app_summary: DemoBank: a fictional banking dashboard (one demo customer, checking + savings) with session entry/logout, account detail, transfers between owned accounts, filterable history and a profile page.

requirements.title: Enter Demo opens the dashboard
requirements.text: The landing page's Enter Demo action opens the dashboard with no password.
requirements.prd_quote: Enter Demo action. It opens the demo dashboard

requirements.title: Header shows active customer and Log out
requirements.text: The header identifies the demo customer and offers Log out.
requirements.prd_quote: header identifies the active demo customer

requirements.title: Logout returns to landing and protects views
requirements.text: After logout the user is on the landing page; protected views cannot be reached by direct navigation, Back or refresh.
requirements.prd_quote: Protected dashboard views should not remain usable after logout

requirements.title: Refresh preserves a valid session
requirements.text: Reloading during a valid session keeps the user signed in.
requirements.prd_quote: Refreshing while in a valid demo session should preserve that session

requirements.title: Accounts listed with name, mask, type, balance
requirements.text: Dashboard shows checking and savings with readable name, masked id, type and USD balance.
requirements.prd_quote: Each account displays a readable account name, a masked account identifier

requirements.title: Balances shown to two decimals
requirements.text: Every balance is shown in USD with exactly two decimals.
requirements.prd_quote: Balances are displayed to two decimal places

requirements.title: No full account identifier exposed
requirements.text: The UI never shows a full account identifier.
requirements.prd_quote: The UI must not expose a full account identifier

requirements.title: Account detail view agrees with dashboard
requirements.text: Selecting an account opens its detail with the same balance and only its own history.
requirements.prd_quote: Selecting an account opens an account detail view

requirements.title: Valid transfer is atomic and exact
requirements.text: Source decreases and destination increases by exactly the amount.
requirements.prd_quote: source balance decreases by the amount and the destination balance increases by the same amount

requirements.title: Transfer creates one record in both histories
requirements.text: One completed record appears in both account histories with amount, source, destination, status and memo.
requirements.prd_quote: creates one completed transfer record that can be found in both relevant account histories

requirements.title: Same-account transfer rejected
requirements.text: Source and destination must differ; rejection changes nothing.
requirements.prd_quote: Same-account transfers must be rejected

requirements.title: Invalid amounts rejected
requirements.text: Blank, zero, negative, non-numeric and >2-decimal amounts are rejected with a message and change nothing.
requirements.prd_quote: Blank, zero, negative, non-numeric, and over-precision values must be rejected

requirements.title: Insufficient funds rejected
requirements.text: An amount above the source balance is rejected; balances and history unchanged.
requirements.prd_quote: The amount must not exceed the source account's available balance

requirements.title: Success shown only after commit; failures explained
requirements.text: Success appears only when committed; rejections say the transfer did not complete.
requirements.prd_quote: The UI reports success only after the transfer has been committed

requirements.title: Transfer survives refresh
requirements.text: After a successful transfer, a reload shows the same updated balances on every view.
requirements.prd_quote: Refreshing after a successful transfer must preserve the updated balances

requirements.title: No duplicate submission
requirements.text: A rapid second click does not submit the transfer twice.
requirements.prd_quote: prevent accidental duplicate submission

requirements.title: Rows show required fields and direction
requirements.text: Each row shows date/time, description, type, account, signed amount and status.
requirements.prd_quote: Amount direction should be clear

requirements.title: Filters show only matching rows
requirements.text: Account, type and status filters (alone or combined) show only rows matching all of them.
requirements.prd_quote: every displayed row must satisfy all selected filters

requirements.title: Date range is inclusive
requirements.text: Transactions on the start or end date are included.
requirements.prd_quote: The start and end dates are inclusive

requirements.title: Empty result shows a clear empty state
requirements.text: A filter with no matches shows an empty state, not an error or unrelated rows.
requirements.prd_quote: An empty result set must show a clear empty state

requirements.title: Clearing filters restores full history
requirements.text: Clear filters returns to the unfiltered list.
requirements.prd_quote: Clearing filters restores the unfiltered history

requirements.title: Profile shows masked synthetic details
requirements.text: Profile shows display name and a masked email.
requirements.prd_quote: display name and a masked email address

requirements.title: Profile leaks no secrets or identifiers
requirements.text: No passwords, tokens or full account identifiers on the profile.
requirements.prd_quote: must not reveal passwords, authentication tokens, full account identifiers

requirements.title: Usable at narrow widths
requirements.text: At a 390px-wide window, key pages fit without sideways scrolling and controls stay visible.
requirements.prd_quote: remains usable at narrower widths

requirements.title: Links lead to the labelled destination
requirements.text: Navigation links open the page they name.
requirements.prd_quote: Navigation links and buttons lead to the labeled destination

requirements.title: Recoverable errors allow retry or return
requirements.text: An error state offers a way to retry or go back to the dashboard.
requirements.prd_quote: A recoverable error must leave the user able to retry or return to the dashboard
